lines.line: Summary: A large reptile of Bayou Nwa in Lemoyne, also found in Bluewater Marsh and parts of Scarlett Meadows around the Kamassa River. It comes in a regular and a small size, and it clamps its jaws on your torso and swings you about, killing you almost instantly.

quoted: The alligator is a large reptile endemic to Bayou Nwa in Lemoyne. They are also found in Bluewater Marsh and some parts of Scarlett Meadows (particularly around the Kamassa River). They come in two sizes - regular and small
The alligator attacks by clamping the torso of the player with their jaw and swinging them about, killing them almost instantly.

lines.line: Weak points: A rifle pierces its tough armoured body plates, and a single rifle shot to the head kills it. A tomahawk thrown at its head kills it instantly, and a bow shot with improved or poisoned arrows straight into the head is a good alternative.

quoted: A rifle will pierce through an Alligator's tough, armored body plates.
alligators can be easily killed via a single shot to the head by a rifle. Throwing a Tomahawk at its head will kill it instantly.
A bow shot with improved or poisoned arrows directly in the head is also a good alternative.

lines.line: Looks like: Green, scaly skin, a long tail, a large gaping mouth and eyes that stick out from either side of the head.

quoted: green, scaly skin, a long tail, a large, gaping mouth and eyes protruding from either side of the head.

lines.line: Tips: A scoped rifle lets you kill one from farther away without getting close. Alligators cannot be skinned in water, so it is best to find and kill one lying on the shore; most of them lie still near the shores of Bayou Nwa and only attack or fight back if you come too close. Small alligators flee when you approach, and your horse gets spooked and throws you off if you ride toward a gator.

quoted: A scoped rifle will allow the player to kill them from a farther distance without having to risk getting too close.
Alligators cannot be skinned in water.
It is best to find and kill an alligator lying on the shore.
most just lie still near the shores of Bayou Nwa and only attack or fight back if the player comes too close to them.
Small alligators, unlike large ones, will flee when the player approaches them.
Horses get spooked and will throw off the player if he rides towards a gator or gets too close.

lines.line: Summary: A wild omnivore found in New Hanover, Lemoyne and West Elizabeth, with the greatest concentration throughout Lemoyne. It drops a boar pelt, tender pork loin, animal fat and a boar tusk.

quoted: Wild Boars can be found across the states of New Hanover, Lemoyne, and West Elizabeth. They are omnivores
the greatest concentration is all throughout Lemoyne.
- Boar Pelt - Tender Pork Loin - Animal Fat - Boar Tusk

lines.line: Weak points: A rifle, or a bow with poison arrows, is the easiest way to take down an animal of its size.

quoted: Using either a rifle or a Bow with Poison Arrows is the easiest way to take down an animal of this size.

lines.line: Tips: You can get a perfect pelt with a rifle, or with a bow using poison or regular arrows. Although it counts as a large animal, a boar can only be skinned like the massive animals such as elk and bison, so it cannot be picked up and stored on your horse.

quoted: The player can obtain a perfect pelt using either a rifle or a Bow with Poison or regular Arrows.
Despite being classed as a large animal, boars can only be skinned akin to massive animals such as Elk and Bison, and thus cannot be picked up and stored on horseback.

lines.line: Summary: Most snakes are venomous and bite if provoked, and they are found in virtually all locations, in higher numbers along the eastern regions, especially Bluewater Marsh and Bayou Nwa. They drop stringy meat, snake skin and a snake carcass.

quoted: Most snakes are venomous and will bite the player if provoked.
The snake can be found in virtually all locations
Higher concentrations tend to be along the eastern regions, especially Bluewater Marsh and Bayou Nwa.
|| Stringy Meat Snake Skin Snake Carcass

lines.line: Weak points: The page names none; snakes try to flee from you, and for a perfect snake skin you have to use a bow with small game arrows.

quoted: Snakes will attempt to flee from the player
To get a perfect snake skin you have to use a bow with Small Game Arrows.

lines.line: Tips: A Health Cure removes the venom from you, and horses are always spooked by snakes. Any perfect snake skin, not just a rattlesnake's, can be used to craft the Rattlesnake Vaquero Saddle from the Trapper, which the page calls arguably the best saddle in the game for all-around balance.

quoted: horses will always be spooked by snakes.
A Health Cure will remove the venom from the player.
The Rattlesnake Vaquero Saddle available from the Trapper is arguably the best saddle in the game in terms of all-around balance
Despite the name, any perfect snake skin can be used to craft this saddle, not just rattlesnakes.

lines.line: Summary: A gang that terrorizes Scarlett Meadows most of all, and the areas around Rhodes and Saint Denis, often with crimes like murder and robbery. They are regularly successful because of their manpower and ammunition.

quoted: they frequently terrorize the areas of Rhodes and the much-bigger Saint Denis. However, they particularly terrorize Scarlett Meadows
often commiting crimes like murder and robberies
They are regularly successful in their crimes due to their amount of manpower, and ammunition unlike other gangs.

lines.line: Weak points: The page names none; it says their strength is manpower and ammunition.

quoted: They are regularly successful in their crimes due to their amount of manpower, and ammunition unlike other gangs.

lines.line: Looks like: Every member wears a grey Confederate-military style uniform with a yellow neckerchief.

quoted: Everyone within the gang consistently wears grey Confederate-military styled uniforms, with yellow neckerchiefs.

lines.line: Tips: A gang of 8 to 12 mounted Raiders can storm you without warning under the rail bridge near Hill Haven Ranch, and the page says deaths in that ambush are notoriously common. Another ambush near Catfish Jacksons uses a wagon-mounted Gatling gun and then reinforcements, and with no cover it is a hard fight. Two unique hats, the Military Officer's Hat and the Military Forage Cap, can be kept from some enemies in random Raider camps.

quoted: The Raiders can launch a very dangerous ambush under the rail bridge near Hill Haven Ranch. A gang of 8-12 mounted Raiders will storm the player without warning and attempt to kill them. Mortality rates for the protagonist are notoriously high in this ambush.

Another random encounter can occur when passing by Catfish Jacksons. The Raiders launch an ambush on the player with a wagon mounted Gatling Gun, while reinforcements arrive and attack the player. Due to a lack of cover, this can be a difficult fight.
The player is able to equip and keep two unique hats from select enemies in random Lemoyne Raider camps. They are the Military Officer's Hat and the Military Forage Cap

lines.line: Summary: A cruel, territorial gang that the page says is intent on controlling the local area and keeping people in terror. They do not camp in the wilderness: you usually meet them while they are looting a travellers' camp.

quoted: The Murfree Brood are known for being unbelievably cruel and territorial
seem intent on controlling the local area and keeping the populace in terror.
Another difference is that the Murfrees don't camp in the wilderness. Instead, players usually encounter the Murfrees while they are looting a travelers' camp.

lines.line: Weak points: The page names none; it says they are unusually durable for human enemies, and have survived point-blank shotgun blasts and in some cases even headshots with lesser firearms.

quoted: Murfrees are unusually durable compared to other human NPCs, being observed surviving point-blank shotgun blasts, and in some cases even headshots with lesser firearms.

lines.line: Looks like: They rarely wear shirts.

quoted: They rarely wear shirts

lines.line: Tips: They frequently use Volcanic Pistols and double-barreled shotguns, which makes close combat with them very deadly. Murfrees do not carry valuables, so looting them mostly gives cigarettes, tonics and herbs, although Murfrees in scripted ambushes always carry money. Their throwing knives can be looted from them too.

quoted: The Murfree Brood frequently use Volcanic Pistols and Double-Barreled Shotguns, making close quarters combat with them a very deadly prospect due to the damage they deal.
the Murfrees don't carry any valuables and players mostly receive cigarettes, tonics, and herbs from looting them.
Murfrees participating in scripted ambushes against the player will always carry money, however.
Additionally, they can be found from looted Murfree Brood members.

lines.line: Summary: A thrown explosive with very high power but low range and low accuracy, of which you can carry up to 8. It cannot be customized.

quoted: !! Power || Very High !! Range || Low !! Ammo Max || 8 !! Accuracy || Low
It cannot be customized.

lines.line: Uses: It can clear out groups of enemies, or blow up mines, trains and safes. Light it and throw it at your target, or put it down, light it and run to a safe distance. It can also blow fish out of the water, but the fish will be of poor quality and you lose a small amount of Honor.

quoted: It can be used to clear out groups of enemies, or effectively blow up a variety of things including mines, trains, and safes. Light and throw towards your target, or place it down before igniting and running to a safe distance.
Dynamite can be used to blow Fish out of the water, thus saving time on fishing. However, not only will the fish be of poor quality, you will lose a small amount of Honor

lines.line: Tips: You cannot buy it from gunsmiths, though some less-than-reputable sellers may stock it; every fence sells it after the mission "Who the Hell is Leviticus Cornwall?", and some missions hand it out. Shooting dynamite makes it explode, including the crates of dynamite found around the map. A Volatile Dynamite pamphlet gives a version with a wider explosion radius, more damage and the ability to ignite a fire, crafted from regular dynamite, animal fat and any type of high velocity cartridge; dynamite can also be used to craft dynamite arrows that explode on impact.

quoted: It cannot be purchased from Gunsmith stores, but some less-than-reputable sellers may stock this item.
This projectile is available from all fences after completing "Who the Hell is Leviticus Cornwall?", and is given out during certain missions.
Shooting dynamite will cause it to explode. This also applies to the crates of dynamite found around the map and in missions.
An improved and more dangerous version of the regular Dynamite, with a wider explosion radius, increased damage, and the ability to ignite a fire.
This upgraded weapon can be crafted using regular Dynamite, Animal Fat, and any type of High Velocity cartridge.
It can also be used to craft dynamite arrows, which will explode upon impact.

lines.line: Summary: A glass bottle of flammable spirits with a cloth fuse that causes a large fireball on impact. It has high power, low range and low accuracy, and it cannot be customized.

quoted: A glass bottle filled with flammable spirits, and topped with a cloth fuse. This explosive projectile will cause a large fireball on impact
!! Power || High !! Range || Low !! Accuracy || Low
It cannot be customized.

lines.line: Uses: It is useful for setting fire to stagecoaches or forcing people and animals to retreat.

quoted: useful for setting fire to stagecoaches or forcing people and animals to retreat.

lines.line: Tips: You can craft one by combining any type of alcoholic spirit with animal fat, or buy one from some less-than-reputable sellers. Every fence sells it after the mission "The Fine Joys of Tobacco", and you can get one earlier by looting enemies. Upgrading the ammo cart to max level provides two fire bottles. The Volatile Fire Bottle does more damage and has a better impact radius, and is crafted from 1 animal fat and 1 moonshine once you have its pamphlet.

quoted: This weapon can be crafted by combining any type of alcoholic spirit with Animal Fat, or purchased from some less-than-reputable sellers.
This projectile is available from all fences after completing "The Fine Joys of Tobacco"
The projectile can also be obtained earlier through looting enemies.
upgrading Arthur's Ammo Cart to max level will provide two Fire Bottles.
The volatile version does more damage and has a better impact radius.
Crafting ingredients require: 1x Animal Fat and 1x Moonshine.

lines.line: Summary: A lightweight thrown axe with moderate power, low range and low accuracy, which can also be used as a close-range melee weapon. It cannot be customized.

quoted: A basic tomahawk with a lightweight wooden shaft and thin blade.
!! Power || Moderate !! Range || Low !! Accuracy || Low
It cannot be customized.
or it can be used as a close-range melee weapon against enemies if needed.

lines.line: Uses: It is ideal for quick thrown attacks, and you can save a trip by picking it up again after throwing. Thrown at an alligator's head, it kills the animal instantly.

quoted: This strong and fast projectile weapon is ideal for quick thrown attacks
or save a trip by recollecting the tomahawk after throwing.
Throwing a Tomahawk at its head will kill it instantly.

lines.line: Tips: You can buy one from some less-than-reputable sellers, and after the mission "The First Shall Be Last" it is available from all fences and the Trapper. Earlier, you can pick one up at Six Point Cabin before the mission "Paying a Social Call" while the hideout is not occupied yet, or find one on broken abandoned stagecoaches around Southern Cumberland Forest.

quoted: It can be purchased from some less-than-reputable sellers
This projectile is available from all fences and the trapper after "The First Shall Be Last".

Alternatively it can be obtained earlier at Six Point Cabin before the mission "Paying a Social Call" where the hideout would not be occupied yet or can be found on broken abandoned stagecoaches around Southern Cumberland Forest.

lines.line: Summary: A small, balanced knife with moderate power, moderate accuracy and low range, thrown at enemies or used in melee. It cannot be customized.

quoted: A small knife with a straight blade, designed and balanced so it can be thrown with ease.
!! Power || Moderate !! Range || Low !! Accuracy || Moderate
It cannot be customized.
or used as a melee weapon if required.

lines.line: Uses: It can silently take down enemies at range, and you can save a trip by picking it up again after throwing. Unlike the hunting knife, a throwing knife and its variants can trigger an instant melee takedown if you equip it and aim at an aggressive enemy at close range.

quoted: Can be used to silently take down enemies at range
or save a trip by recollecting the knife after throwing.
Unlike the Hunting Knife, the throwing knife and its variants can trigger an instant melee takedown if the player equips it and aims at an aggressive enemy at close range.

lines.line: Tips: A poisoned throwing knife, crafted at a campfire from a throwing knife and Oleander Sage, guarantees certain death for an NPC once any attack with it starts, and it makes legendary animals and dangerous wild animals such as grizzly bears, cougars and panthers run away after one attack; it turns back into a regular knife once you recover it. The improved throwing knife, crafted at a campfire from a throwing knife and rare bird feathers, may guarantee an instant kill where a regular one can be survived. You get your first one in the mission "Paying a Social Call", and a fence or the Trapper sells them after it.

quoted: the Poison Throwing Knife, also craftable at a campfire, can be crafted with an existing throwing knife and Oleander Sage.
Equipping a poisoned throwing knife and initiating any sort of attack with an NPC regardless of health will guarantee certain death.

Legendary Animals and dangerous wild animals like grizzly bears, cougars and panthers can be dealt with using one poisoned knife attack and they will run away from the player when hit, instead of staying and fighting back.
Poisoned throwing knives turn into regular throwing knives after being recovered.
The Improved Throwing Knife can be crafted at a campfire with an existing throwing knife and rare bird feathers
NPCs can survive being hit with a regular throwing knife while improved throwing knives may guarantee an instant kill.
This projectile is provided during "Paying a Social Call", and can be purchased from a Fence or the Trapper after completion.

lines.line: Summary: A two-shot shotgun with high power but low range and low accuracy, made for close quarters on foot or on horseback. It can be fired with one hand or dual wielded, and unlike other shotguns it occupies a holster/handgun slot.

quoted: !! Power || High !! Range || Low
!! Ammo Capacity || 2
!! Accuracy || Low
can be used easily with one hand or dual wielded to great effect.
this weapon is ideal for close quarter combat on foot or on horseback.
Unlike other shotguns, this one occupies a holster/handgun slot

lines.line: Uses: Dual wielding it with a second sawed-off shotgun is highly effective for quickly eliminating anything in your way, man or beast. It takes regular buckshot, incendiary buckshot, slug and explosive slug.

quoted: Dual-wielding it with another Sawed-Off shotgun is highly effective, allowing the quick and brutal elimination of anything that stands in your way, man or beast.
This gun has an ammo capacity of two rounds and can use Regular Buckshot, Incendiary Buckshot, Slug and Explosive Slug shotgun ammo.

lines.line: Tips: You are given one in the mission "Enter, Pursued by a Memory", and you can buy a second from any gunsmith for $85.

quoted: it is provided by Javier Escuella during the mission "Enter, Pursued by a Memory". A second one can be bought from any Gunsmith, for the price of $85.
